I added a test that replays the recording and fails for the reason the slice names. I only added `tests/test_expiring_today.py`, and I didn't touch source or any existing test.

The test posts the milk (expires 2026-10-21) and the yogurt (expires 2026-10-23). It then asks for `/items/expiring?days=3&today=2026-10-21` and expects both items, milk first. The server returns only the yogurt. The expected list comes from the recording's `expected` field, not from running the code.
